projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: AAVA connectivity from Development instance to Production instance is blocked, limiting capability to use AAVA fully for code/refactoring effort (EMS biweekly audit 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Critical development and refactoring workflows may remain constrained if connectivity issues persist beyond planned resolution timeline.
riskDescription.consequence: Development velocity could decline, delaying feature delivery and increasing manual effort costs while undermining the value proposition of agentic workflow adoption.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with AAVA Platform Team and Premera to resolve production instance connectivity and establish daily status checkpoints until resolved.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon connectivity failure exceeding five business days, activate manual code refactoring workflows and escalate to Engineering Manager and AAVA leadership within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Active internal technical barrier documented in EMS with Overall and Timeline RAG at Amber; AAVA Platform Team troubleshooting underway but no resolution date confirmed.

riskDescription.context: Scope changes from UX standpoint and business angle are emerging as external requests, with all scope to be triaged based on available bandwidth (EMS biweekly audit 2026-06-04, Scope RAG: Amber).
riskDescription.condition: Uncontrolled scope expansion may exceed team capacity if triage and prioritization processes do not keep pace with incoming change requests.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines could slip, or critical baseline features may be deprioritized, eroding client satisfaction and margin.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal scope change assessment process with Product Owner to evaluate impact and prioritize requests weekly based on team bandwidth.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should approved scope changes exceed available capacity, rebaseline delivery plan with Premera and defer non-critical features to Phase 2 within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Scope RAG moved to Amber with active external change pressure documented in EMS; bandwidth-based triage indicates capacity constraint risk.

riskDescription.context: Dependency with Data Hub is external, and the current Data Model provided by Product Owner as of 6/3 will be used for development (EMS biweekly audit 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Data model changes or delays from the external Data Hub team may require rework or stall integration activities.
riskDescription.consequence: Integration testing could be delayed, and late-stage schema changes may trigger costly refactoring and timeline extensions.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly Data Hub alignment meetings with Product Owner to validate data model stability and communicate integration requirements proactively.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once Data Hub schema changes are confirmed, assess integration impact within 24 hours and rebaseline affected sprint deliverables with Premera approval.
risks.reasoning: External dependency flagged in EMS with Scope and Timeline at Amber; single-source signal with no confirmation of Data Hub delivery stability.

riskDescription.context: AAVA deployment does not feature logging and monitoring, requiring support from Premera, and metrics are not available from AAVA to track actual progress gains (EMS biweekly audit 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Observability gaps may prevent early detection of AAVA performance issues or accurate measurement of productivity improvements.
riskDescription.consequence: Undetected defects or inefficiencies could surface late in the cycle, and the business case for AAVA adoption may be difficult to validate, weakening stakeholder confidence.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with Premera infrastructure team and AAVA Platform Team to implement logging and monitoring on AAVA client instance by sprint end.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should logging setup delay beyond two weeks, implement manual AAVA performance tracking via daily developer surveys and escalate observability gap to Delivery Manager.
risks.reasoning: Internal gap documented in EMS; go-green plan includes coordination with Premera and AAVA teams, but no setup completion date provided.

riskDescription.context: Citrix environment is experiencing slowness and frequent disconnection, impacting delivery (EMS biweekly audit 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Persistent Citrix performance issues may reduce developer productivity if client infrastructure support does not resolve the instability promptly.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint velocity could decline, and team morale may suffer, increasing attrition risk and delaying deliverables.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise Citrix performance ticket with Premera infrastructure support and track resolution daily until stability is restored to baseline levels.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When Citrix downtime exceeds four hours per day, activate backup VDI restart protocol and notify Delivery Manager to escalate with Premera leadership.
risks.reasoning: Infrastructure issue documented in EMS with planned ticket escalation to Premera; Quality and Talent RAG remain Green, suggesting impact is contained but not yet resolved.

riskDescription.context: Scope changes in terms of UX and Infra Setup are being discussed, with triage based on available bandwidth (EMS biweekly audit 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Late-stage infrastructure or UX design changes may introduce technical debt or require architecture rework if not fully scoped and resourced.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment defects or performance issues could emerge, increasing support costs and delaying production readiness.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define UX and infrastructure change impact assessment criteria with Product Owner and conduct technical feasibility review before approval each sprint.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should late-stage UX or infrastructure changes introduce technical debt, document architectural trade-offs and defer non-critical enhancements to post-production support phase.
risks.reasoning: Scope discussion ongoing per EMS; combined with Scope and Timeline Amber RAG, indicates active change management pressure with uncertain resource allocation.
